thread:
Maya Chen: FYI opening a quota + subnet port issue for a new tenant in norwayeast. Provisioning keeps failing on ND40rs and NC24rs SKUs, and NSG port limits look like the blocker. Ticket RT-987654 opened with Azure.
Sanjay Patel: Thanks Maya — can you paste the subscription ID and the exact error? Also which resource group / vnet?
Maya Chen: sub: 84a7-9f2b-az1, rg: redwood-prod-norwayeast, vnet: rwd-prod-vnet-ne
Maya Chen: Error from our deploy job:
```
ERROR: VM provisioning failed for vm-node-az-01: Allocation failed. Compute resources in region 'norwayeast' with sku 'ND40rs_v2' are unavailable for subscription '84a7-9f2b-az1'.
InnerError: NSG rule 'deny-ephemeral-ports' hit 65000/65535 ephemeral ports.
```
Leo Anders: ugh ephemeral port exhaustion again. Is this the same tenant that had heavy parallel evals last week?
Maya Chen: yes, same tenant. They spin up ~1200 short-lived pods, each does gRPC to control plane.
InfraBot: Reminder: runbook for Azure GPU quota requests -> https://intranet.redwood/infra/runbooks/azure-gpu-quota
Ashley R.: @Sanjay if quota is available we can request reservation, but NSG port limit needs flow log and port reopening. Azure suggests using NAT gateway or SNAT scaling.
Sanjay Patel: Can someone run a quick check for current NSG SNAT usage on that vnet? I can also try a temporary reroute to francecentral if capacity exists.
Eli Tran: ran `az network watcher show-topology` and `az network watcher test-nsg-flow` — SNAT table shows >60k ephemeral mappings.
Eli Tran: Quick mitigation: enable Azure NAT gateway on subnet that pods egress from, that should free SNAT on the gateway and reduce ephemeral exhaustion.
Maya Chen: If we enable NAT gateway, do we need new public IP prefix? Cost headcount question from finance — want an estimate.
Ashley R.: NAT gateway + public IPs: expect ~$0.045/hr per NAT gateway + public IPs/addresses. For a 3-day emergency it's cheaper than failed deployments and reserved capacity gaps. I'll draft cost note.
Sanjay Patel: On reservation side, Azure told us ND40rs capacity is constrained in norwayeast and we need to submit quota + reservation with preferred start date. They gave a quota ticket ID AZ-QR-4123 to link to RT-987654.
Maya Chen: I updated RT-987654 with subscription, vnet, sample deploy logs. Azure FE asked for peak vCPU and whether we can accept ND40rs -> NDv4 fallback if unavailable.
Leo Anders: Fallback plan: allow provisioning on NC24rs (cheaper) but with lower FP throughput. We should flag model SLAs. Also we can route non-latency-critical jobs to francecentral.
Eli Tran: Small config snippet to check pod egress subnet (k8s):
```
kubectl get svc -n mlworkloads -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.externalTrafficPolicy}'
kubectl describe nodepool rwd-gpu | grep Subnet
```
Maya Chen: Azure support asked for counts by SKU and timeline. Sent them: ND40rs: 24, NC24rs: 48 peak in first week; steady 8 afterwards. Also asked for expected gradelog.
InfraBot: Incident CREATED: RT-987654 linked to AZ-QR-4123. Priority: High. Assigned: Sanjay Patel. ETA for Azure FE response: 6-12 hrs.
Ashley R.: Cost estimate posted to #finance: temporary NAT + 48h fallback capacity to francecentral = ~$2.8k. PM approves if < $5k emergency spend.
Sanjay Patel: Azure FE responded — provisional quota increase approved for NC24rs (12 units) in 48 hours, ND40rs requires quota + stock confirmation — they need regional capacity confirmation.
Maya Chen: Action items: (1) Enable NAT gateway on pod-egress-subnet (Leo), (2) Confirm reservation request + link RT-987654->AZ-QR-4123 (Sanjay), (3) Add route to francecentral for best-effort jobs (Eli).
Leo Anders: I'll spin NAT gateway and update subnet, scheduler policy to reduce ephemeral ports by pooling connections. ETA 3 hrs.
Eli Tran: I'll add taints/tolerations for francecentral fallback and a label to mark non-urgent jobs. Will post k8s rollout snippet after NAT is up.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Please paste final commands and ticket updates here when done. :thumbsup:
Leo Anders: NAT gateway done, associated with subnet, publicIP prefix 13.45.77.0/28. Verified egress and SNAT reduced to ~2k.
Eli Tran: Pushed rollout policy, label `region-fallback=francecentral` and updated CI to annotate jobs that can be routed. Test deploy to francecentral succeeded.
Sanjay Patel: Updated RT-987654 with Azure FE message, linked AZ-QR-4123. NC24rs mini-approval in 36 hrs per FE. ND40rs pending stock check; they suggested considering NDv4 in alternate regions.
Maya Chen: closing loop: we have mitigation in place (NAT + fallback), tracking quota/reservation with Azure. I'll log postmortem if this recurs. Closing thread later.
InfraBot: RT-987654 status -> Mitigation in place. Will auto-close after 7 days if no regressions.
